messages:
Sam (sales): FYI customer ACME can't call the hosted POC endpoints after we exchanged SAML metadata this morning. Getting 401s. Can someone triage?
Priya (solutions): ugh. Which key? Hosted API key or the SAML assertion failing? any error body?
Sam (sales): They see `401 Unauthorized` and this in the response: `invalid_saml_assertion: Assertion expired`. They said the IdP clock might be skewed.
Jules (eng): Assertion expired usually means issue on IdP side (NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter). Can you paste the SAML response (redacted) or just the timestamps?
Sam (sales): forwarded the SAML response to priya and jules DM. Customer says Okta set TTL to 5m instead of 15m for the assertion.
Priya (solutions): Ok. Two paths: ask IdP to extend assertion window OR we can allow a 2m skew tolerance on our SAML verifier for POC. Need eng approval.
Jules (eng): We can add a temporary 2m fudge in the verifier for the tenant but need a security signoff first. Risk is trivial for a timeboxed POC.
Maya (security): We can approve a temporary tolerance for a signed, timeboxed change. Security questionnaire item 3.2 also requires audit of IdP clocks. Can sales capture the contact for their IdP admin so we can get confirmation?
Sam (sales): ACME has given admin contact: @acme-idp-admin. I'll loop them in. Also ACME asked if we can generate a hosted API key while SAML is being fixed — they need to validate throughput.
Jules (eng): For Hosted API keys we can issue a short-lived key scoped to the POC tenant. That's faster than changing SAML. We should create it with limited rate/cost caps.
Priya (solutions): Pricing note: short-lived hosted key for POC is free for first week, but if they want Dedicated pool trial we need a reserved commit and pricing talk. Sam pls flag if ACME asks about Dedicated.
Sam (sales): flagged. For now they'd like a hosted key for load testing and a workaround so SCIM provisioning can finish.
Jules (eng): SCIM failing because the SCIM sync webhook is retrying with the SAML auth header failing. Workaround: create a SCIM service account token (longer TTL) for the POC until IdP is fixed. Need ops to create a token bound to `scim:write` only.
Riley (infra-bot): Request accepted: scim-poc-token create requested by Jules. ETA ~ 15m. Request id: rq_7f9b.
Sam (sales): Awesome. Also ACME security asked for our security questionnaire answers for SAML/SCIM flows (SAML signing alg, KMS usage, key rotation cadence). Maya is taking this.
Maya (security): I'll upload answers to the shared drive shortly and add the required KMS diagram. One note: if we issue a short-lived hosted API key, we need to log it in the audit trail and rotate after 7 days.
Priya (solutions): Can we also offer a Dedicated trial with isolated pool for ACME? They need to test multi-tenancy isolation and bring-your-own-key. That will surface whether their SCIM/IdP gives consistent assertions after sustained traffic.
Jules (eng): Dedicated trial is possible but needs infra lead signoff and a temporary capacity allocation. Not immediate. For POC path: (1) short-lived hosted API key for throughput; (2) scim service account token for provisioning; (3) temporary SAML time tolerance if ACME confirms IdP clock skew.
Sam (sales): I'll propose that plan to ACME and ask for the IdP admin confirmation. Also will include pricing pointer for Dedicated trial and next steps.
Riley (infra-bot): scim-poc-token created: token_id tok_poc_3k9b (expires in 14 days). Audit: created by infra-bot on behalf of Jules.
Jules (eng): Token looks good. I deployed a canary rule for tenant to allow +2m assertion skew until 2195000360 (6 minutes). This is logged in rollout: `canary/tenant/acme/skew-+2m`
deploy-bot: Rollout `canary/tenant/acme/skew-+2m` started by Jules.
Maya (security): I'll put the +2m tolerance in a temporary exception doc and notify compliance. Please ensure customer signs the POC MOU acknowledging the exception.
Sam (sales): Sent MOU to ACME and included the workaround steps. Customer confirmed they can now GET /v1/health and POST /v1/chat with the hosted key.
Priya (solutions): great. Follow up items: confirm IdP TTL change, rotate hosted POC key after 7 days, close the security questionnaire items. Sam plz collect ACME IdP admin confirmation and paste here.
Sam (sales): ACME idp admin confirmed they will increase assertion TTL to 15m and fix clock on their side by EOD. I'll post proof when done. Thanks all! :tada:
